run_gaia2_init: run gaia2-init to split a scenario JSON into per-app state files and create events.jsonl
decode_attachments_in_state: decode base64-encoded email and messaging attachments from app state and write them to disk
init_filesystem: create a filesystem directory tree from scenario state files with backing file support
create_app_class_map: create an app_class_map.json mapping canonical app names to scenario class names
split_scenario_json: split a scenario JSON into individual per-app state files in a target directory
